problem: JANUS must be able to consume external information without allowing foreign model-generated behavioural traits to become persistent JANUS identity, policy, persona, or training signal.

research_basis.finding: Teacher behavioural traits can transfer through semantically unrelated generated data during distillation; semantic filtering is not a sufficient boundary.
Some Phantom Transfer constructions survive data-level filtering and full paraphrasing, motivating provenance/model-level controls.
Increasing independent model-generated distillation data can make latent teacher traits more recoverable in students.

memory_planes.REFERENCE: external/user/model material; facts only; no persona/style/goal inheritance
memory_planes.QUARANTINE: unknown lineage or invalid identity/policy writes

training_rule.scaling_tripwire: record foreign sample count and independent teacher lineages; increasing scale never upgrades trust

outbound_rule.goal: JANUS may propagate its declared own lineage to authorized JANUS components

scope_limit: Application-level provenance/memory/training admission cannot remove traits already present inside third-party foundation-model weights. Model-level auditing or a controlled JANUS-owned model stack is required for that stronger guarantee.
